messages:
mira: Quick triage — roadmap planning next week. Need to lock API surface + SDK contract decisions for the Q2 launch. Top customer asks we're hearing: 1) stable function-calling types for TS/Py, 2) structured-output schema support + validators, 3) typed embeddings responses + batching, 4) rerank API signature. Also need examples, changelog guidance, and launch gating criteria. Can we agree owners and minimal acceptance criteria? cc @devon @sam @jing

devon: I can take TS types + examples. Proposal: land types + example PR together, add type-tests in CI. Will sketch minimal TS API surface by EOD Mon.

sam: I'll own Python client typings and migration guidance. For runtime, recommend TypedDict + optional runtime validation. Backcompat rule: keep old signature for 2 releases with deprecation warning.

jing: I'll take structured-output validators and example schemas. My proposal: add optional `schema` param to chat call and plumb a validator hook in SDK (opt-in). Example usage:
```
client.chat.create(prompt, { schema: { type: 'object', properties: { answer: { type: 'string' } } } })
```
Also will prepare a short set of example JSON schemas.

devon: TS sketch (very rough):
```
type ChatResponse<T = unknown> = { output: T; tokens: number; }
function chat<T>(prompt: string, opts?: { schema?: JSONSchema7 }): Promise<ChatResponse<T>>
```
We should land TS types + examples in same PR so downstream users see usage patterns.

sam: Changelog proposal: include a dedicated "compatibility" section per release with a breaking-change level (none / minor / major) + migration steps. Add a migration checklist for function-calling changes.

mira: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
1) End-to-end example in both Python & TS for function-calling + schema support.
2) Type-tests passing in TS CI.
3) Runtime validator + 2 e2e tests (happy path + schema error).
4) Docs + changelog entry + migration guide.
5) Any breaking changes must have deprecation notice + 2-release window.
Agree?

devon: :thumbsup: I'll draft PRs. ETA EOD Tue.

api-bot: RFC PR opened — https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/212 — contains initial schema param + types proposal, discussion in PR.

jing: Note: customer FinCorp requires signed schemas for private deployments. Might need an opt-in `require_schema_signing` flag and KMS integration. Flagging for security review.

mira: Good catch — I'll loop in @security once drafts are up.

sam: Also calling out embeddings batching: add `batch_size` + streaming partial results for large sets. I'll add a benchmark ticket to measure latency vs cost.

devon: Quick call on rerank: keep rerank as separate endpoint `POST /v1/rerank` that returns a scores array (not embeddings). Anyone object?

jing: No objections. Separate endpoint keeps semantics clear.

calendar-bot: Design review scheduled: 2026-03-24 10:00am PT — invite sent to mira, devon, sam, jing.

mira: Thanks all. Action items: devon — TS PR + type-tests; sam — Py PR + changelog template + benchmarks; jing — schema validator + security note. I'll assemble roadmap slide for the planning meeting. Closing thread.
